message: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading update)
finding: Both errors were reproduced in the unmodified official app before MCT was loaded. The callbacks dereference a missing start-screen resizer. This diagnosis is limited to the tested isolated Windows profile; it does not assert every Blockbench installation is affected.
resolution: No MCT plugin patch is indicated. Keep upstream errors and independent control evidence, retain 12 passing model/renderer checks, and keep the native filesystem permission-flow limitation explicit.
